title: Development Status — VSCode Extension + Orchestrator Stubs (2026-05-03)
summary: VSCode extension is ~70% complete. Core SSE client, webview lifecycle, and v11 reflection rendering are production-ready. Three stub files and missing formal error boundary are the remaining gaps. Five orchestrator placeholder functions must be replaced before Phase 2 batch missions can operate.

completed: MCPClient.ts — SSE connection, session isolation, JSON-RPC dispatch, 2min timeout, progress streaming
App.tsx — v11 reflection rendering, log export, bridge status polling, auto-scroll, settings integration
extension.ts — SovereignAgentViewProvider, 4 command registrations (runMission, sensorSweep, healthCheck, checkBridgeStatus)
incomplete: context.ts (450 bytes) — DDD context caching not implemented
executor.ts (1001 bytes) — execution plan persistence not implemented
registry.ts (627 bytes) — tool registry caching not implemented
SSE reconnect: onDisconnect event emitted but reconnect is manual (UI must re-initiate)

next_sprint_recommendations: Implement runMissions with Promise.allSettled + concurrency limiter (p-limit or manual semaphore)
Add React.ErrorBoundary in App.tsx around main render tree
Implement context.ts: store DDD context per sessionId in VSCode ExtensionContext.workspaceState
Add SSE auto-reconnect with exponential backoff in MCPClient.ts
Wire getVersionsHierarchy to scan /versions folder (or git tags) for actual version data
